title: Burden of valvular heart diseases: a population-based study.

title: Colorectal cancer: CT colonography and colonoscopy for detection--systematic review and meta-analysis.
reason: Systematic review and meta-analysis of the sensitivity of CT colonography and colonoscopy.

title: The clinical diagnosis of osteoporosis: a position statement from the National Bone Health Alliance Working Group.

title: Mummified Thyroid Syndrome.

title: Thyroid Nodule Shape Independently Predicts Risk of Malignancy.

title: Diagnosis of thyroid nodules.
reason: Review of thyroid nodule diagnosis.

title: Mixed valvular heart disease: diagnosis and management.

reason: Review calling for diagnostic stewardship of blood cultures.

title: Pediatric procedural sedation and analgesia in the emergency department: surveying the current European practice.
reason: Survey of European procedural sedation practice.
